records.part: on-premises SharePoint software being replaced due to end of sale/support
records.reason: The product shall replace the end of sale/support of current on-premises Microsoft SharePoint 2019 software with an announced end date of July 14, 2026.

records.part: alternative digital experience platform solution evaluated and rejected
records.reason: Adobe's Experience Manager (Java based) for Cloud services will cost around $565K (extra costs for web analytics capability).

records.part: alternative digital experience platform solution evaluated and rejected
records.reason: OpenText (Java based) will cost around $397K for one year but additionally we'll also have to incur costs for upkeep of the infrastructure in the cloud environment.

records.part: alternative digital experience platform solution evaluated and rejected
records.reason: Liferay (Java based) will cost about $294K per year. Liferay does not integrate with County technologies as easily and is not as user friendly for agency authors.

records.part: core Microsoft SharePoint functionality retained after decommissioning SharePoint 2019
records.reason: SharePoint 2019 will be decommissioned but SharePoint Subscription Edition (SE) will still be necessary for core Microsoft functionality.

records.part: Agreement for Sitecore Digital Experience Platform software-as-a-service, No. PNC2130956A1
